# Startup, window geometry and preferences
GetAutostart - Read whether Gitbox starts at login.
GetLanguage - Read the window's interface language.
GetOS - Identify the operating system showing the window.
GetPeriodicSync - Read the configured fleet-check interval.
GetStartupSnapshot - Load the initial config, nesting and event watermark together.
GetStartupTiming - Read timing marks for the current startup.
GetUIMode - Read the preference for simple or advanced controls.
GetWindowMode - Select the main, remote, terminal or host-management view.
IsFirstRun - Decide whether to show onboarding.
MarkStartup - Record a renderer startup milestone.
SetAutostart - Enable or disable launching Gitbox at login.
SetCollapsed - Save the selected view, tree folds and sidebar state.
SetLanguage - Save the window's interface language.
SetPeriodicSync - Change the fleet-check interval.
SetShowPullPlan - Save whether Pull all opens its plan.
SetTheme - Save the light, dark or system theme preference.
SetUIMode - Change which controls the interface shows.
ShowWindow - Reveal the window after the renderer applies its layout.

# Configuration, onboarding and clone roots
AcknowledgeConfigError - Dismiss the configuration load error for the session.
AddRoot - Register another directory for local clones.
AdoptFirstProject - Link an existing clone during onboarding.
GetConfig - Read the effective config with local window preferences.
GetConfigLoadError - Read the error that prevented loading the configuration.
GetConfigPath - Locate the active configuration file.
InitRoot - Create the initial configuration with a selected clone root.
ListConfigBackups - List backups available for configuration recovery.
ListRoots - List registered clone roots and their availability.
PickFolder - Ask the user to select a local directory.
PreviewClonePath - Resolve the planned destination for a project.
PreviewRoot - Inspect a clone-root candidate before accepting it.
ReloadConfig - Re-read configuration and preferences from disk.
RemoveRoot - Remove a clone root and optionally forget its tracked clones.
RepairConfig - Salvage usable entries from a damaged configuration.
RestoreFromBackup - Recover configuration from the selected backup.
SetDefaultRoot - Select the default destination for new clones.

# Accounts and credentials
AccountDeletionImpact - Preview the clones and folders affected by deleting an account.
AddAccount - Add a Git provider account and its identity.
ChangeCredentialType - Switch the account's authentication method and reconfigure its clones.
CredentialDelete - Remove saved credentials for an account.
CredentialRegenerateSSH - Replace the SSH key used by an account.
CredentialSetupGCM - Prepare Git Credential Manager for the account.
CredentialSetupSSH - Set up SSH authentication and return instructions.
CredentialSSHAgentReport - Report the account key's SSH agent state.
CredentialStoreToken - Store a provider token for an account.
CredentialVerify - Check the account's configured credential.
DeleteAccount - Remove an account and optionally delete its clone folders.
DiscardAccount - Roll back an account left unfinished by setup.
GetTokenGuide - Read the provider's token creation instructions.
RenameAccount - Rename an account and update its references.
SuggestAccountKey - Suggest an unused key for a provider identity.
UpdateAccount - Save account changes and propagate them to its clones.

# Git checks and scheduled work
CheckGlobalGCMConfig - Inspect the global Git credential helper setup.
CheckGlobalGitignore - Inspect the managed global ignore configuration.
CheckGlobalIdentity - Detect a global identity that may interfere with account identities.
DoctorPrecheck - Check the tools required by the selected credential method.
DoctorRun - Run the environment diagnostics shown in the Doctor dialog.
FixGlobalGCMConfig - Repair the global Git Credential Manager configuration.
GetCheckGlobalGitignore - Read whether to check the global ignore setup at startup.
GetIdentityProof - Show the effective Git identity and authorization evidence for a clone.
GetScheduledTasks - Show configured task intervals and recent task state.
InstallGlobalGitignore - Install or update the managed global ignore block.
IsGlobalGCMConfigNeeded - Decide whether the fleet requires global Git Credential Manager setup.
OpenRepoConfigInEditor - Open a clone's Git config in a local editor for inspection.
RemoveGlobalIdentity - Remove the global Git identity entries on request.
RepairRepoIdentity - Reapply the tracked account identity to a clone.
RunTask - Request a run of a named scheduled task.
SetCheckGlobalGitignore - Save whether to check the global ignore setup at startup.

# Repository discovery, cloning and updates
AddDiscoveredRepos - Track selected provider repositories in a source.
BeginStatus - Start an initial status scan or join the active scan.
CloneRepo - Create a tracked clone in the chosen root.
ConfirmSweep - Apply the reviewed branch sweep after checking the preview is current.
CreateNewRepo - Create a provider repository and optionally clone it.
DeleteRepoFolder - Delete a tracked repository's local clone folder.
Discover - Start discovery of provider repositories for an account.
FetchRepo - Fetch a single tracked clone.
GetAllStatus - Read the current fleet status results.
GetRepoDetail - Show a clone's branch, working tree and incoming history.
ListAccountOrgs - List organizations the account can select as repository owners.
ListRemoteRepos - List provider repositories visible to an account.
PreviewPullAll - Prepare a pull plan with eligible and skipped clones.
PreviewSweep - Inspect a clone and prepare a branch sweep preview.
PullAll - Run the reviewed pull plan for the fleet.
PullRepo - Update a single tracked clone.
RefreshStatus - Request a new status scan.
StopTrackingRepo - Remove a repository from tracking while leaving its folder in place.

# Workspaces, adoption and pull request badges
AdoptClones - Track selected existing clones with the selected accounts.
GetNestedScanDepth - Read the discovery depth for nested clones.
GetPRSettings - Read whether PR badges and draft PRs are shown.
IgnoreClone - Exclude or re-include a folder in clone reconciliation.
Reconcile - Reattach recognized clones and report unmatched folders.
RepoNesting - Read which tracked repositories appear under other clones.
RepoWorkspaceFiles - List workspace files at a container's root.
ScanFolderForClones - Find existing clones inside a selected directory.
SetNestedScanDepth - Save how far to scan for nested clones.
SetPRBadgesEnabled - Toggle PR badges for tracked clones.
SetPRIncludeDrafts - Toggle draft PRs in badge summaries.
SetRepoContainer - Mark a repository as containing other clone folders.
SetRepoWorkspace - Select the workspace file to open for a container.

# Mirrors
AddMirrorGroup - Define a mirror group for two accounts.
AddMirrorRepo - Add a repository and direction to a mirror group.
ApplyDiscoveredMirrors - Save mirror relationships found during discovery.
CheckMirrorCredentials - Check the credentials and scopes needed for mirroring.
DeleteMirrorGroup - Remove a mirror group from configuration.
DeleteMirrorRepo - Remove a repository from a mirror group.
DiscoverMirrors - Look for existing provider mirror relationships.
GetMirrorStatus - Request status for a mirror group.
SetupMirrorRepo - Set up the configured mirror through the provider.

# Launchers and terminal manager
MissingModernTerminal - Decide whether to show the Windows Terminal notice.
OpenAccountFolder - Reveal an account's clone directory in the file manager.
OpenAccountInAIHarness - Launch the selected harness for an account folder.
OpenAccountInApp - Launch the selected editor for an account folder.
OpenAccountInBrowser - Open the provider page for an account through the link confirmation flow.
OpenAccountProfile - Launch a terminal profile in an account folder.
OpenFileInEditor - Open a selected local file in the editor.
OpenInAIHarness - Launch the selected harness in a clone folder.
OpenInApp - Launch the selected editor in a clone folder.
OpenInBrowser - Open an external link through the link confirmation flow.
OpenInExplorer - Reveal a local path in the file manager.
OpenProfile - Launch a terminal profile at a selected path.
OpenRepoInBrowser - Open a repository's provider page through the link confirmation flow.
OpenTerminalsManagerWindow - Show the standalone terminal profile manager.
RedetectProfiles - Detect terminals and shells and return the refreshed config.
RefreshAIHarnesses - Refresh available harnesses where the clone workflows run.
SaveTerminalProfilesDTO - Persist terminal apps, shells and profiles from the terminal manager.

# Remote hosts and windows
AddRemote - Save a new SSH host in the remote host list.
ConnectRemote - Open or focus a window for the selected SSH host.
GetRemoteTint - Read the local tint preference for remote windows.
ListRemotes - Read saved remotes and their client-side status.
ListSSHHosts - List SSH config aliases that can be added as remote hosts.
OpenRemotesWindow - Show the standalone remote hosts manager.
RemoteDisconnect - End this window's connection to its host.
RemoteInfo - Read the remote window's connection state and host metadata.
RemoteLog - Read recent connection log lines for the current remote window.
RemoteReconnect - Reconnect this window to its saved host.
RemoteReinstall - Reinstall the host's matching Gitbox server and reconnect.
RemoteRunDoctor - Run diagnostics on the connected host.
RemoteUninstall - Remove the Gitbox server installation from a selected host.
RemoveRemote - Forget a remote host from the local list.
SetRemoteEditor - Save the editor command used for a specific remote host.
SetRemoteTint - Save the tint color for remote windows.
ShowLocalWindow - Bring the local fleet window to the front.
ShowRemoteLog - Open the selected host's window with its connection log visible.
ValidateRemotePath - Check whether a typed path is valid on the connected host.

# Diagnostics, recipes and application updates
ApplyRecipeImport - Apply a reviewed add-only fleet recipe import.
ApplyUpdate - Install the available application update.
CheckUpdateRecovery - Offer a rollback after a failed launch or confirm a healthy startup.
ExportDiagnostics - Save the inspected diagnostics bundle to a chosen file.
ExportRecipe - Save a portable fleet recipe to a chosen file.
OpenRecipeImport - Choose and read a fleet recipe file.
PreviewDiagnostics - Prepare a diagnostics bundle for review before saving.
PreviewRecipeExport - Prepare a portable recipe for review.
PreviewRecipeImport - Show the changes proposed by a recipe and its slot mappings.
ResolveUpdateRecovery - Decide whether to restore the previous application build.
